content.text: The pod event message is clear: the Corvane CSI driver is being rejected by the storage array (`cv-array-02`) because the host group `hg-k8s-prod` has hit its 512-LUN-mapping cap. This is an external storage-array limit, not a Kubernetes misconfiguration, and resolving it requires changes on the array (clean up stale LUN mappings or move the node to another host group) that I can't make or safely advise on without the storage team.

input.reason: clickhouse-2 is stuck in ContainerCreating because the Corvane CSI driver's ControllerPublish/NodeStage is being rejected by storage array cv-array-02 with error CVN-4127: host group hg-k8s-prod has reached its max of 512 LUN mappings. This is a storage-array-side limit that needs the storage/SAN admin to clean up stale LUN mappings (or move node ip-10-0-93-12 into a host group with capacity). Not resolvable from Kubernetes config.
